page.title: Imprint Random Walk NFT
page.subtitle: A Random Walk NFT takes 50% off the cost of one ETH gesture. Imprint one here, then attach it to the gesture you choose.
page.costBreakdown: Contract cost {base} ETH, plus a {percent}% buffer so the imprint still succeeds if the cost rises before it confirms.
page.connect: Connect a wallet to imprint a Random Walk NFT. Connecting signs nothing.

gesture.title: Half off one ETH gesture
gesture.label: Saved on one ETH gesture at today’s cost
gesture.caption: Half of today’s ETH Gesture Cost of {cost} ETH. Each Random Walk NFT gives this once, in the gesture you choose.

anchoring.title: Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection
anchoring.body: Anchored, a Random Walk NFT takes part in the Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection: at every finalization, {count, plural, one {# anchored Random Walk NFT is} other {# anchored Random Walk NFTs are}} selected, and each one’s holder receives {cst} CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT. Using an NFT in a gesture does not stop it from being anchored.

success.title: Random Walk NFT {id} is yours
success.description: Attach it to an ETH gesture for a one-time {percent}% reduction in the Gesture Cost.

owned.unknownNote: Whether these Random Walk NFTs were used could not be checked right now, so none is offered for a gesture yet.
owned.empty: This wallet holds no Random Walk NFTs yet.
owned.error: The Random Walk NFTs in this wallet could not be read.
